title: 真实SSH证书撤销：只撤指定序列号，叠加旧KRL并保留同钥其他证书
source: OpsForge 身份与安全补充编审
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现revoke_certificate(certificate,prior,output)。仅接收本题有效Ed25519用户证书和既有二进制KRL，将该证书按OpenSSH证书身份加入既有撤销列表，生成独立0600输出；保留过去的撤销，不得撤销整CA、底层用户公钥、同一公钥的其他序列号证书或其他CA同序列号。用真实ssh-keygen -L/-Q校验，使用-k -u在私有候选副本更新，再替换输出。输入为普通非符号链接文件，输出不与输入同路径或符号链接。畸形/原始公钥/损坏KRL和覆盖输入ValueError，失败保留输出及输入并清理.krl-*。重复加入应保持撤销语义。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实OpenSSH签发短期有效教学证书、二进制KRL增量更新与-Q检查。与032仅将原始公钥放入新KRL不同，本题考察CA内证书序列号范围及旧撤销叠加。这里只验撤销工件，不代表sshd RevokedKeys分发或新会话拒绝、已有会话终止和离线节点隔离已完成；保留原题完整处置说明供后续验收。无真实身份/系统信任库/默认SSH配置变更，不构建镜像。
rubric: 使用OpenSSH支持的撤销列表或KRL并通过RevokedKeys等机制分发，明确序列号或密钥范围
核对文件可读性和节点生效状态，以新会话验证被撤证书拒绝；已有会话不会因文件更新自动结束，离线节点应隔离或完成撤销同步后再开放

test_files.checks/check.py:
import json,os,pathlib,secrets,shutil,stat,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
def run(args):return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=4)
def key(name):
 p=run(['ssh-keygen','-q','-t','ed25519','-N','','-f',name]);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
def sign(keyfile,ca,serial,target):
 p=run(['ssh-keygen','-q','-s',ca,'-I','owned-'+secrets.token_hex(3),'-n','training','-V','-1m:+10m','-z',str(serial),keyfile+'.pub']);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 shutil.copyfile(keyfile+'-cert.pub',target)
def query(krl,certificate):
 p=run(['ssh-keygen','-Q','-f',krl,certificate])
 assert p.returncode in (0,1),(p.returncode,p.stderr)
 if p.returncode==1:assert 'REVOKED' in p.stdout+p.stderr
 return p.returncode==1
for name in ('ca','other-ca','shared-user','previous-user','bystander'):key(name)
serial=secrets.randbelow(100000)+100
sign('shared-user','ca',serial,'target-cert.pub');sign('shared-user','ca',serial+1,'same-key-other-serial.pub')
sign('previous-user','ca',serial+2,'previous-cert.pub');sign('bystander','other-ca',serial,'other-ca-same-serial.pub')
p=run(['ssh-keygen','-k','-f','prior.krl','previous-cert.pub']);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
assert query('prior.krl','previous-cert.pub') and not query('prior.krl','target-cert.pub')
assert not query('prior.krl','same-key-other-serial.pub')
print('NATIVE_OPENSSH_UNEXPIRED_SIGNED_CERTIFICATES_PRIOR_KRL_AND_SAME_KEY_DIFFERENT_SERIAL_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:add_only_approved_certificate_serial_preserve_prior_revocations_and_ca',flush=True)
inputs={name:pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes() for name in ('prior.krl','target-cert.pub','ca.pub','shared-user.pub')}
try:task.revoke_certificate('target-cert.pub','prior.krl','updated.krl')
except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('additive certificate-scoped KRL update failed') from error
assert query('updated.krl','target-cert.pub'),'target certificate still accepted by KRL query'
assert query('updated.krl','previous-cert.pub'),'existing certificate revocation was lost'
assert not query('updated.krl','same-key-other-serial.pub'),'same key with a different serial was over-revoked'
assert not query('updated.krl','other-ca-same-serial.pub'),'same serial issued by other CA was over-revoked'
assert not query('updated.krl','shared-user.pub') and not query('updated.krl','ca.pub'),'raw user key or entire CA was revoked'
assert all(pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()==data for name,data in inputs.items())
assert stat.S_IMODE(pathlib.Path('updated.krl').stat().st_mode)==0o600 and not list(pathlib.Path('.').glob('.krl-*'))
stable=pathlib.Path('updated.krl').read_bytes()
task.revoke_certificate('target-cert.pub','updated.krl','second.krl')
assert query('second.krl','target-cert.pub') and query('second.krl','previous-cert.pub') and not query('second.krl','same-key-other-serial.pub')
pathlib.Path('broken.pub').write_text('ssh-ed25519-cert-v01@openssh.com AAAA invalid\n')
pathlib.Path('broken.krl').write_text('not a binary KRL\n')
for certificate,prior,output in [('shared-user.pub','prior.krl','updated.krl'),('broken.pub','prior.krl','updated.krl'),('target-cert.pub','broken.krl','updated.krl'),('target-cert.pub','prior.krl','prior.krl'),('target-cert.pub','prior.krl','target-cert.pub')]:
 before={name:pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes() for name in (certificate,prior,output)}
 try:task.revoke_certificate(certificate,prior,output)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('unsafe raw key, malformed KRL or input overwrite accepted')
 assert all(pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()==data for name,data in before.items())
 assert pathlib.Path('updated.krl').read_bytes()==stable and not list(pathlib.Path('.').glob('.krl-*'))
print('NATIVE_KRL_CERTIFICATE_SERIAL_CA_SCOPE_PREVIOUS_REVOCATIONS_RAW_KEYS_AND_FAILURE_OUTPUT_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
